title: SYNTHETIC: packing soft-looking shapes
summary: SYNTHETIC DATA: An invented audience watches objects being fitted into a small shape; the repost is dependent.
counterevidence: No actual independent audience observation exists in this fixture.
analogs: Synthetic packing puzzle with no commercial data.
risks: Simple reskin would not create a distinctive game decision.
next_test: Show one playable packing cycle to a small target audience and record whether the objective is understood.

title: SYNTHETIC: rotating a gate
summary: SYNTHETIC DATA: An invented paid ad contains a rotating gate; organic demand is unobserved.
gameable_action: Rotate one gate to route a moving object.
player_choice: Choose orientation before the next moving object arrives.
counterevidence: Only a fictional advertisement is described; there is no observed gameplay session.
risks: Might be entertaining to watch but frustrating to control.
next_test: Build a one-screen gate interaction and observe unprompted attempts to improve timing.

title: SYNTHETIC: limited-space bubbles
summary: SYNTHETIC DATA: A fictional listing describes tapping bubbles; user retention is unknown.
gameable_action: Tap bubbles before they fill the screen.
player_choice: Choose which bubble to remove to preserve future space.
counterevidence: No verified store statistics or player behavior exist in the fixture.
analogs: Synthetic bubble tapping puzzle with unknown audience.
risks: Tapping may be purely reactive without meaningful choice.
next_test: Compare a version with spatial consequences against a version with simple scoring.
